page_title: FIO 2-2 LEC | Fiorentina v Lecce 27/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the left post.
90+4' Wonderful movement by Fiorentina. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Federico Di Francesco (Lecce) replaces Lameck Banda.
90' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
86' Gabriel Strefezza goes off the pitch and Alexis Blin (Lecce) comes on.
82' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to make a change. Gino Infantino (Fiorentina) replaces Alfred Duncan.
82' Substitution. Christian Kouame (Fiorentina) in, Giacomo Bonaventura out.
82' The Fiorentina players can’t believe it after referee Maria Ferrieri Caputi signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.

82' Play continues despite the shouts by some Fiorentina players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Maria Ferrieri Caputi interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
81' Surely that's handball by one of the Lecce players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
81' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Good work from Fiorentina as they win a corner.
80' The foul by Josip Brekalo (Fiorentina) was seen by Maria Ferrieri Caputi who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

76' 2 - 2 Goal! Lameck Banda hands Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) the simplest of tasks from close range after the cross evaded the keeper, and he makes no mistake with his header into the roof of the net. 2:2.
75' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
75' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
72' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) replacing Arthur Melo.
72' The referee signals a substitution. Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) is brought on as a substitute for Hamza Rafia.
71' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
68' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
68' Josip Brekalo (Fiorentina) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

68' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Fiorentina will take a corner kick.
66' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
66' Lecce quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lucas Beltran leaves the pitch and M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) comes on.
65' Here is a change. Riccardo Sottil is going off and Vincenzo Italiano gives the last tactical orders to Josip Brekalo (Fiorentina).
64' The ball is cleared after Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lecce.
63' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
59' Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
59' Lameck Banda (Lecce) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
57' Marin Pongracic (Lecce) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post.
54' Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
53' Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.

49' 2 - 1 2:1. Hamza Rafia (Lecce) latches on to a pass on the edge of the penalty area and immediately fires a fantastic first-time shot into the top right corner of the net. What a finish that is! Oliver Christensen did his best to stop it, but the shot was just too good. Mohamed Kaba provided the assistance.
48' Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Joan Gonzalez (Lecce) comes off for Mohamed Kaba.
46' The substitution is prepared. Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Antonino Gallo.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+4' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
45+3' Dodo (Fiorentina) is adjudged offside.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
42' Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) picks up an accurate pass inside the box and unleashes a shot goalwards that smashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.

40' Fiorentina slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
36' The corner from Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) is hurriedly cleared.
36' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Lecce win a corner.
32' Fiorentina seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
29' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lecce, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
29' Lecce are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
28' Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) jumps into a tackle and Maria Ferrieri Caputi signals a foul.
26' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.

25' 2 - 0 A perfect lofted pass from Arthur Melo finds Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header into the right side of the goal. His effort was both strong and precise, and Wladimiro Falcone had no chance of stopping that. 2:0.
23' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lecce.

22' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Lecce will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
21' Dodo (Fiorentina) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
20' Dodo (Fiorentina) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
19' Close! Lameck Banda (Lecce) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.

17' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
15' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box. His effort heads for the top of the net, but Wladimiro Falcone denies him.
15' Marin Pongracic (Lecce) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
15' Fiorentina have a free kick.
13' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
12' The game is interrupted now, Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
11' A pass from Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) is intercepted by Oliver Christensen and the move breaks down.
10' Fiorentina take a quick free kick with a short pass and play continues.
10' Foul! Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. A free kick is awarded to Lecce.
9' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Fiorentina comes to nothing.
9' Dodo (Fiorentina) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball is out of play. Fiorentina will have a chance to score from a corner.

7' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Fiorentina are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.

3' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) gets on the scoresheet after converting a chance from the resulting corner kick. He finds himself some space inside the box and plants a perfect header down inside the right post. 1:0.
3' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Fiorentina.
3' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Fiorentina can continue in their attacking effort.
2' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. It's a throw-in for Fiorentina.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
We have just got the news that the match will be delayed due to technical problems.
The players are out at last! Fiorentina will take the kick-off.
Maria Ferrieri Caputi is introduced as the referee for today's match.
